jobs.title: Remote Project Manager
jobs.description:
Benefits:

Bonus based on performance
Profit sharing

Remote Project Manager – Kitchen & Bath Remodeling

Kitchen Tune-Up & Bath Tune-Up

Remote Position Supporting North Atlanta, Georgia Projects

Compensation: $12 per hour | Full-Time, 50 Hours per Week

Benefits

Performance-based bonuses
Long-term career advancement opportunities
Remote work
Opportunity to grow with an expanding remodeling company

Create Raving Fans & Make Money!

Kitchen Tune-Up and Bath Tune-Up is seeking an experienced Remote Project Manager
to coordinate residential kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects throughout North Atlanta.

This is a full-time remote position for someone who can successfully coordinate 10-20 active remodeling projects simultaneously
while maintaining exceptional standards for scheduling, client communication, documentation, material ordering, quality control, project cycle times, and budget performance.

Our goal is straightforward: Create Raving Fans & Make Money!

The right candidate has strong experience managing U.S. residential kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects. They are highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, comfortable holding installers and trade partners accountable, and committed to doing things the right way—even when no one is watching.

Compensation

$12 per hour
50 hours per week
Performance-based bonuses tied to measurable results, including:
Client satisfaction and 5-star Google reviews
On-time project completion and cycle times
Budget and gross-margin performance
Accurate and timely material ordering
Project documentation and communication
Minimal delays, rework, callbacks, and warranty issues

Opportunity for increased responsibility and career advancement based on performance

What You’ll Do

You will report to the Operations Manager and remotely coordinate multiple residential remodeling projects from pre-construction preparation through final completion.

Project Management and Scheduling

Coordinate 10-20 active kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects simultaneously
Review project scopes, plans, measurements, selections, specifications, budgets, and schedules before construction begins
Confirm that field measurements and site conditions have been properly documented before materials are ordered
Develop, maintain, and update realistic project schedules
Coordinate installers, trade partners, vendors, deliveries, inspections, and homeowners
Confirm daily installer attendance, progress, and next steps
Identify potential delays, missing materials, or cost overruns early and develop corrective action plans
Keep projects moving efficiently while minimizing downtime between construction phases
Ensure work remains within the approved scope and budget
Track pre-construction walks, start dates, countertop templating, installations, inspections, final walkthroughs, punch lists, completion dates, and outside dates
Protect project gross margin by actively managing labor, materials, change orders, rework, and scheduling

Material Ordering and Production Coordination

Review approved proposals, plans, selections, and measurements before ordering
Prepare and maintain detailed material lists and project-ordering trackers
Coordinate the ordering of cabinetry, cabinet-refacing materials, countertops, tile, plumbing fixtures, hardware, lighting, and related products
Confirm order acknowledgments, lead times, delivery dates, quantities, specifications, and finishes
Track whether materials have been ordered, received, inspected, and assigned to the correct project
Communicate proactively regarding backorders, damaged products, missing materials, and substitutions
Coordinate deliveries with vendors, Field Supervisors, installers, and clients
Help prevent ordering errors, jobsite delays, duplicate purchases, and unnecessary expedited-shipping costs

Quality Control and Documentation

Review daily jobsite photographs, videos, installer reports, and project updates
Confirm that completed work appears consistent with the approved scope, plans, selections, and Kitchen Tune-Up standards
Escalate potential quality concerns to the Field Supervisor or Operations Manager immediately
Maintain accurate project notes, schedules, photographs, documents, and communications in company systems
Track open items, deficiencies, punch-list work, callbacks, and warranty issues through completion
Help reduce rework by identifying inconsistencies, missing information, and potential problems early
Confirm that every project has complete and organized documentation

Client Experience

Provide homeowners with timely and professional project updates
Set clear expectations regarding schedules, upcoming work, required decisions, deliveries, and project milestones
Communicate proactively—especially when challenges, changes, or delays arise
Respond promptly and professionally to client questions and concerns
Coordinate project walkthroughs and ensure punch-list items are documented and resolved
Help create Raving Fans who confidently recommend Kitchen Tune-Up and leave 5-star Google reviews

Installer, Trade Partner, and Team Coordination

Build productive working relationships with installers, trade partners, vendors, and internal team members
Communicate daily with field personnel regarding attendance, progress, materials, quality, and upcoming work
Hold installers and trade partners accountable for schedules, communication, documentation, and commitments
Confirm that installers submit required jobsite photographs, videos, time records, and daily reports
Communicate project risks, delays, client concerns, and resource needs to the Operations Manager
Participate in daily project huddles, production meetings, operations meetings, and client calls
Prepare clear meeting notes, action items, deadlines, and follow-up communications
Follow through until every assigned task and project issue is fully resolved

Budget and Change-Order Management

Monitor project budgets, labor costs, material expenses, and gross-margin performance
Compare proposed work with actual field conditions and client requests
Identify work that falls outside the approved proposal
Prepare change-order information for management review before additional work begins
Track approved change orders and confirm that they are incorporated into schedules and project documentation
Help prevent unauthorized work, unapproved material purchases, and avoidable cost overruns

What Success Looks Like

The Remote Project Manager will be evaluated on their ability to help us Create Raving Fans & Make Money
, including:

Projects completed on schedule
Accurate and continuously updated project schedules
Projects completed within budget and gross-profit targets
Timely and accurate material ordering
Minimal ordering mistakes, delays, rework, callbacks, and warranty claims
Client satisfaction and 5-star Google reviews
Proactive client and team communication
Complete and accurate project documentation
Installer and trade-partner accountability
Fast identification and resolution of project risks
Ability to manage 10-20 active projects without sacrificing quality, client care, or profitability
Consistent ownership, responsiveness, and follow-through

Qualifications

Required

At least 3 years of project-management experience involving U.S. residential construction or remodeling
Direct experience managing kitchen, bathroom, cabinetry, or residential renovation projects
Demonstrated ability to coordinate more than five active projects simultaneously
Strong knowledge of U.S. residential construction methods, terminology, and sequencing
Working knowledge of cabinetry, countertops, tile, plumbing, electrical, flooring, and finish carpentry
Experience reviewing plans, measurements, scopes of work, specifications, and product documentation
Experience coordinating materials, installers, subcontractors, vendors, and project schedules
Strong understanding of quality control, job costing, change orders, and gross-margin management
Excellent written and spoken English
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills
Ability to communicate professionally with U.S. homeowners, installers, vendors, and team members
Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new software quickly
Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, headset, webcam, and distraction-free home workspace
Ability to remain available and responsive throughout scheduled working hours
Three professional supervisor references

Preferred

Experience with high-end residential remodeling
Experience working remotely for a U.S. construction or remodeling company
Experience with Buildertrend, ServiceMinder, 2020 Design, Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace, Zoom, or comparable systems
Experience ordering cabinetry, refacing materials, countertops, tile, plumbing fixtures, and remodeling products
Experience managing more than 10 active remodeling projects simultaneously
Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills
Relevant construction, design, estimating, or project-management education or certifications

Schedule

Full-time: 50 hours per week
Monday through Saturday
Must be available during the company’s required working hours in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone
Attendance at daily huddles, production meetings, operations meetings, and client calls is required
Occasional evening availability may be required based on client or project needs
This is a remote position, but it requires consistent availability, professional communication, and active engagement throughout the workday

Who Thrives Here

You May Be a Strong Fit If You:

Take complete ownership and follow through
Hold yourself and others accountable at an A-player level
Notice details others miss
Communicate problems early instead of allowing surprises
Respond promptly and understand that radio silence is unacceptable
Respect clients, teammates, installers, trade partners, and their time
Remain calm, resourceful, and solutions-focused under pressure
Can manage multiple priorities without losing track of details
Understand that excellent client service and profitable operations go hand in hand
Always strive to do the right thing
Want to build a long-term career with a growing remodeling company

About Kitchen Tune-Up

Kitchen Tune-Up provides kitchen remodeling and improvement solutions designed to transform clients’ homes while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

We believe remodeling should improve both the beauty of a home and the lives of the people who live there. We combine thoughtful planning, excellent craftsmanship, proactive communication, and disciplined project management to deliver outstanding results.

Our Operating Principles

Client Experience: Treat every homeowner and home with care, honesty, and respect.
Quality: Deliver craftsmanship we are proud to stand behind.
Ownership: Take responsibility for results and solve problems proactively.
Communication: Keep clients and teammates informed—no surprises and no radio silence.
Discipline: Protect schedules, budgets, margins, and company resources.
Continuous Improvement: Learn from every project and continuously improve our systems.
Purpose & Profit: Create Raving Fans & Make Money! Create exceptional value for clients while building a profitable, strong, and sustainable business.

Apply Today

Please Submit:

Your résumé
A brief summary of your U.S. kitchen and bathroom remodeling experience
A list of the project-management and construction software you have used
Your internet speed and home-office setup
Three professional supervisor references

Qualified applicants should be prepared to discuss specific projects they have managed, the number of simultaneous projects they coordinated, and examples of how they protected schedules, budgets, quality, and client relationships.

Engineering background, preferably Electrical Engineering or Automation
Familiar with project management tools (e.g. MS-Project, SAP)
Customer-oriented
Strong sense of responsibility

More About Us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and

manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Mission Statement:
Unlocking potential while protecting your most critical assets.

Core Values:
Care Trust Help (C.T.H.)

Summary Of Position

The Project Manager is responsible for managing assigned projects across Niles' lines of business, including industrial coatings, roofing, industrial maintenance, mechanical restoration, scaffold and insulation, facility services, and other specialty services. Projects may range from $20,000 to $2,000,000 or more in value depending on scope and complexity.

The Project Manager is responsible for project planning, execution, financial performance, customer satisfaction, production tracking, and subcontractor coordination. This role works closely with field leadership and internal departments, including purchasing, workforce dispatch, safety, equipment, and operations, to deliver projects safely, efficiently, and profitably while maintaining the highest level of service for our customers.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Project Management & Execution

Manage assigned projects from initiation through closeout, ensuring successful execution of scope, schedule, budget, quality, and customer expectations.
Develop project execution plans, schedules, staffing requirements, and resource strategies to support efficient project delivery.
Coordinate project activities with estimators, field leadership, customers, subcontractors, suppliers, and other trades.
Collaborate with operational leaders to ensure projects are properly staffed, equipped, and scheduled for safe and productive execution.
Lead pre-job, progress, and post-job meetings and communicate project status to customers, field leadership, and internal stakeholders.
Monitor project performance, identify risks and obstacles, and implement corrective actions as needed.
Conduct regular jobsite visits to support field teams, strengthen customer relationships, and ensure project objectives are achieved.
Maintain complete and accurate project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

Financial Management

Develop and maintain project budgets, forecasts, and cost tracking.
Monitor project financial performance, identify variances, and implement corrective actions to achieve profitability goals.
Review labor productivity, material costs, subcontractor expenses, and equipment utilization.
Manage project billing requirements and support timely invoicing and collections activities.
Identify, price, negotiate, and manage change order opportunities.

Contract & Risk Management

Review, interpret, and administer project contracts, terms, conditions, and commercial requirements.
Identify potential contractual, operational, financial, and safety risks and develop mitigation strategies.
Ensure compliance with contractual obligations while protecting company interests.
Lead dispute resolution efforts and support claims management when required.
Evaluate project opportunities and risks to support strategic decision-making.

Customer & Business Relationship Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and project stakeholders.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships that support long-term business partnerships.
Coordinate project activities with customers, subcontractors, suppliers, and other trades.
Partner with Account Managers and Operations Leadership to identify opportunities for additional work and customer growth.

Safety, Quality & Compliance

Promote a culture of safety and ensure compliance with all company safety policies and customer requirements.
Support field leadership in the identification and resolution of safety, quality, and operational concerns.
Ensure projects are executed in accordance with contractual obligations, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.
Participate in post-project evaluations and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project outcomes and operational effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management or a related field preferred
Two (2) to five (5) years of project management, construction management, operations, or related industry experience.
Experience working in industrial, manufacturing, power generation, or heavy commercial environments with industrial coatings, roofing, mechanical restoration, HVAC, or specialty contracting environments preferred.
Demonstrated understanding of project budgeting, forecasting, job costing, and financial management principles.
Knowledge of contract administration, change management, and project financial reporting.
Strong organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and project management software.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Valid driver's license with the ability to travel to project sites overnight up to 25%.

Role Purpose

This role is accountable for management and the safe execution of engineering projects, assist in preparation of engineering tender responses and provision of engineering technical services and applications support for power generation related products.

Dimensions

This role may or may not have direct reports
Interface with Sales, Service, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Product Managers, Suppliers & Customers

Nature and Scope

This role is accountable for management and execution of engineering projects, assist in preparation of engineering tender responses, provision of technical services and applications support for sales and field service for customised products in CAPS.

Key Accountabilities

Leadership

Demonstrate professional and ethical business conduct at all times.
Demonstrate a strong commitment to personal choice in your own safety.
Be aware of your colleagues health and safety, contributing to a strong safety culture
Participate in a regular active Toolbox safety meetings.

Project Management and Execution

For engineering projects assigned to you:
Execute overall project management
Review project technical scope, budget, delivery requirements and assess feasibility
Ensure technical compliance with project specifications and applicable standards
Ensure project outputs meets the needs of your customer.
When required, attend project site
Manage projects to be on-budget against an ‘as ordered’ PMU.
Manage projects to be delivered in full, on time.
Report weekly the status of all projects - cost, payment milestones, delivery or technical issues.
Conduct project close out reviews to review success and to document lessons learned.
Where required attend or host meetings with clients, suppliers or subcontractors in support of project completion.

Tender analysis, preparation and support

Where required, assist sales team in reviewing tenders and other forms of RFQ and:
Conduct Intial feasibility assessment of opportunity.
Communicate with Finance regarding applicable CAPS commercial conditions.
Communicate with Sales when tender or RFQ submission dates cannot be met.
Interpret technical project specifications.
Write technical and commercial exceptions to specifications protecting CAPS and the customer.
Select appropriate equipment and customisations to meet the specifications and site conditions.
Conduct basic preliminary design in support of accurate costings and information for customers.
Conservatively estimate final costs for OEM equipment and customisations to specifications.
Follow the standard process for engineering tender response generation.
Support sales with technical assistance in post submission TQs, meetings and presentations.

Engineering Customisation of Product

Execute engineering design for technical aspects of customisations and modifications to Product within my qualifications and level of experience, including:
Component and Equipment selection
Conducting competent electrical and/or mechanical design (where applicable)
Provision of technical documentation and drawings
Provision of quality plans, ITPs, test & commissioning procedures, project schedule and other miscellaneous documentation

Work with Engineering Services in KL for cost efficient documentation generation and document control
Communicate with OEMs to monitor delivery and configuration of equipment to ensure they meet the specification and customer’s requirement.
Work closely with all stakeholders (internal and external) to ensure modifications are fit-for-purpose and costed appropriately to optimise profit margins.

Product Validation

To inspect, evaluate and test as necessary all engineering project related equipment, materials and works completed by OEM manufacturers, suppliers, subcontractors and manufacturing / service departments to ensure it meets the project specified output performance, quality requirements and applicable Australian standards.

ISO 9001 and Process Improvement

Ensure all my activities with my engineering role are aligned with the requirements of the CAPS ISO9001 system and the processes defined within CAPS Promapp.
Where required, participate fully in audits of engineering process by internal and external auditors.
Where required participate in process improvement activities and projects.
Map and update key engineering processes into Promapp as part of our regular engineering activity.

General Administration

Ensure accurate timesheets are kept updated every week so that:
The engineering cost center accurately reflects chargeable vs non chargeable activity.
Pronto Jobs reflect a true account of engineering effort required in execution.

Conduct other reasonable engineering and business related duties, within my capacity and qualifications, as assigned by my manager from time to time.
To work efficiently and comply with all company policies and procedures.
Complete all training requirements assigned to me, in person, or on the CAPS PDP platform as required.
Operate at all times within any limits assigned to me under the CAPS Authority Matrix for expenditure and quotations.

Critical Behaviours

Safety First in all that I do – without exception.
Results Orientation – On time, On Budget.
Commercial Acumen – Effective Milestone Management
Analytical Thinking – Is the obvious solution the best solution?
Continuous Improvement – How do we do better?

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to deliver the emergency services program within Leo Global Customer Operations. This is a cross-functional role responsible for driving standardization, strategy, and execution of telecommunications and call center operations across American and international markets, ensuring customers can access critical emergency connectivity when every second matters.

You will build and run the day-to-day program, drive BPO partner strategy, launch readiness, and ongoing operational excellence for emergency services contact center operations spanning multiple countries, languages, and regulatory environments. You will apply your domain expertise in emergency services protocols, contact center operations, and global program management at scale to deliver the program successfully.

Own the program strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end execution for our call center operations and telecom needs
Own vendor/BPO partner relationships for contact center operations including selection, onboarding, performance management, quality oversight, and service level governance
Execute and deliver scalable solutions that support multiple countries, languages and regulatory environments
Drive cross-functional coordination across internal and external teams including engineering, operations and other support teams
Develop and execute launch playbooks for new market expansions, ensuring operational readiness across training, technology, workforce planning, and compliance requirements
Establish and monitor key operational metrics, escalation frameworks, and continuous improvement mechanisms for emergency services delivery
Ensure compliance with emergency services standards, protocols, and regulatory requirements (e.g., eCall, NG911, E112) across all supported markets
Apply program management methodologies to develop large-scale project plans, milestones, and mechanisms that drive predictable outcomes across the program lifecycle

Saab Australia is an industry participant in the Combat Systems Integration – Integrated Project Team (CSI-IPT) Collaboration Agreement (CSI-IPT CCA). The role

The Project Manager

Foster a positive collaborative culture between the key project stakeholders and the project team including the customer (both external and internal), and other stakeholders.

jobs.title: Sonoma Water Climate Resiliency Program Manager - Extra-Help
jobs.description:
Position Information

The Sonoma County Water Agency
(Sonoma Water) is looking for an experienced Extra-Help Climate Resiliency Program Manager to support their initiatives in energy and climate resiliency!

For priority consideration, please apply to this Extra-Help recruitment by 7/1/26.

Responsibilities

The Climate Resiliency Program Manager - Extra-Help will support the climate resiliency team at Sonoma Water. This position will conduct research, perform analysis, and facilitate meetings to advance the phased rollout of Sonoma Water’s 2021 Climate Adaptation Plan and its 2023 Climate and Energy Resiliency Policy. Additional responsibilities will include:

Developing policies and plans to guide Sonoma Water’s climate resiliency portfolio
Reviewing work plans and proposals for natural and built infrastructure projects to align with best practices for utilizing climate datasets and methodologies for adaptive management
Researching and presenting to executives the emerging issues related to catastrophic flood risk, weather trends, climate-related risks, infrastructure impacts, and compounding hazards
Collecting, analyzing, and interpreting a variety of reports and spatial data
Utilizing project management tools, including task planning, budgeting, and time monitoring, to effectively deliver on project goals
Participating in committees and task forces within Sonoma Water, as well as through collaborations with local and regional partners
Building relationships with key internal and external partners to advance Sonoma Water’s climate equity strategy

The Ideal Candidate For This Position Will Be Deeply Committed To Community Building And Will Bring Extensive Experience In Both Program Management And Public Sector Planning. They Will Also Possess Many Of The Following

Knowledge of climate science and a practical understanding of climate adaptation strategies
Academic background in fields such as climate science, geography, environmental studies, natural resources, conservation, hydrology, planning, public policy, or political science
Demonstrated success in managing projects, evaluating results, meeting program objectives, and setting clear priorities and strategic initiatives.
Experience facilitating collaborative planning and building consensus among diverse stakeholders
Strong desire to promote collaboration through the development of transparent, results-oriented strategies that enhance coordination and drive shared success
Exceptional abilities in communication, program oversight, data analysis, and report preparation

Extra-Help Employment

Extra-help employees relieve or augment permanent staff. Temporary, extra-help employees are not in the classified civil service and do not have property rights to permanently allocated positions. In addition, they do not receive most employee benefits such as long-term disability insurance coverage, accrual of vacation, participation in the County retirement program, or eligibility to take promotional examinations. Temporary
, extra-help employees are limited in their employment to a maximum of one calendar year. These employees must be off of work for three months before they can be re-employed on an extra help basis.
Extra-help employees who meet the eligibility requirements may qualify for a County contribution toward medical coverage.

This recruitment is being conducted to fill a Climate Resiliency Program Manager temporary, e xtra-help position at Sonoma Water. This employment list may also be used to fill future extra-help positions as they occur during the active status of the list. The formal title of this position is Department Program Manager.

For priority consideration, please apply to this Extra-Help recruitment by 7/1/26.

Application submissions require the Supplemental Questionnaire to be completed.

Minimum Qualifications

Experience:
Any combination of training and experience which would provide an opportunity to acquire the knowledge and abilities stated herein. Normally, three years of experience supervising or coordinating a program including some responsibility for program coordination, planning, analysis and administration, including at least one year leading or supervising staff would provide such opportunity. Specific experience related to the assigned position may be required for designated positions and will be stated as such in recruitment materials.

Education:
Any combination of education and training which would provide the opportunity to acquire the knowledge and abilities stated herein. Normally, significant college coursework in business or public administration, finance, economics or a closely related area would provide this opportunity. For some assignments, college coursework in social work, psychology, sociology or a closely related field may be desirable.

License:
Possession of a valid driver's license at the appropriate level including special endorsements, as required by the State of California, may be required depending upon assignment, to perform the essential job functions of the position.

The position advertised on this announcement does not require possession of a valid California Driver’s License.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Considerable knowledge of:
the principles and practices of program management including planning and program analysis; data collection, research methodology and application of basic statistics; report writing; legislation, laws, current issues and trends, and techniques and principles for the assigned program area.

Working knowledge of:
the principles and practices of personnel management, employee supervision, and training; budget development and fiscal management; grant and contract administration.

Ability to:
plan, organize, coordinate and manage a specific program or group of related programs; select, train, and supervise staff; develop, evaluate, and analyze operational policies and procedures; analyze problems and complaints and identify solutions; prepare, interpret and evaluate a variety of narrative and statistical data and reports; communicate orally and in writing on a variety of issues; understand, interpret and apply procedures, laws, rules and regulations as they apply to assigned area; ensure proper compliance with federal, state and local guidelines, policies, goals, rules and regulations; develop and maintain harmonious relationships with employees, public officials, community groups, other agencies and the general public.

Selection Procedure & Some Helpful Tips When Applying

Your application information and your responses to the supplemental questions are evaluated and taken into consideration throughout the entire selection process.
You should list all employers and positions held within the last ten years in the work history section of your application. Be as thorough as possible when responding to the supplemental questions.
You may include history beyond ten years if related to the position for which you are applying. If you held multiple positions with one employer, list out each position separately.
Failure to follow these instructions may impact your competitiveness in this process or may result in disqualification.

Please visit Getting a Job with the County of Sonoma to review more detailed information about the hiring process, including the application process, examination steps, and department selection process.

Application submissions require the Supplemental Questionnaire be completed.

Responses to supplemental questions are used to evaluate your qualifications. Please provide sufficient information to allow for a thorough evaluation of your qualifications.

The Selection Procedure Will Consist Of The Following Examination

An Application and Supplemental Questionnaire Appraisal Examination
(pass/not pass) will be conducted to evaluate each applicant's combination of educational coursework, training, experience, knowledge, and abilities that relate to this position to ensure satisfaction of the minimum qualifications for this position. Candidates who possess the minimum qualifications for the position will be placed on an extra-help employment list and referred to the department. The department may contact candidates from the employment list who possess the most appropriate job-related qualifications for further consideration.

Additional Information

A background investigation is required prior to employment. Candidates referred to departments for a selection interview are typically required to sign authorization and release forms enabling such an investigation. Failure to sign prescribed forms will result in the candidate not being considered further for that vacancy. Reference information will not be made available to candidates.

Additional requirements, such as successful completion of a physical exam, drug screen, etc., may apply, depending on the duties and responsibilities of the position. If you receive a conditional job offer for the position, the requirements upon which the offer is contingent will be outlined in the conditional job letter. You may also review the Job Classification Screening Schedule to determine the requirements for this position.

How To Apply

Applications are accepted online at www.yourpath2sonomacounty.org . Paper applications may be submitted by person, fax (707-565-3770), email, or through the mail. All applications and appropriate supplemental information as outlined in the job bulletin must be received by the time and date specified on the first page of this job announcement. Continuous recruitments may close without notice at any time that a sufficient number of qualified applications have been received. Applications received after the recruitment closes will not be accepted.

We are committed to having a diverse workforce that is representative of the communities we serve. The County is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer where all aspects of employment are based on merit, competence, performance, and business need.

Job Summary

The Technical Program Manager (TPM) will be based in San Jose, CA and will lead cross-functional technical programs with US-based customers, customers’ in-region teams in Asia, and our internal teams across the US and Asia. This role will coordinate engineering, R&D, NPI, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain activities across facilities in the US, China, Korea, and Vietnam to ensure timely execution, clear communication, and high-quality outcomes.
The TPM will serve as a key technical and program interface, helping translate customer requirements into executable development and manufacturing plans, driving issue resolution, and supporting successful product launches from early development through production ramp.

Product Focus

The TPM will primarily support technical programs involving energy storage, automotive, robotics, and advanced manufacturing applications. Product categories may include precision components, electrical and mechanical assemblies, and customized manufactured parts.
Relevant processes may include die-cutting, stamping, molding, laminating, converting, assembly, and automation-related integration.
Material areas may include films, tapes, adhesives, insulation materials, plastics, foams, metals, and other engineered materials.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead technical programs from initiation through launch, ensuring alignment with customer requirements, internal standards, timelines, and business objectives.
Serve as the primary technical and program liaison with US-based customers, while coordinating closely with customers’ in-region teams in Asia.
Coordinate with internal engineering, quality, manufacturing, logistics, and supply chain teams across the US and Asia.
Support R&D and New Product Introduction (NPI) activities, including prototype builds, engineering trials, pre-production validation, and production ramp-up.
Provide hands-on technical support, including issue investigation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, corrective action follow-up, and technical risk assessment.
Drive regular program reviews, track open issues, document action items, and communicate clear status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Identify program risks, bottlenecks, and gating items, and implement proactive mitigation plans.
Coordinate customer visits, factory visits, readiness reviews, audits, and technical reviews across applicable manufacturing sites.
Ensure customer expectations, technical requirements, quality standards, and manufacturing readiness are clearly understood and executed across all regions.
Support clear documentation, including meeting minutes, project timelines, technical summaries, readiness checklists, and launch plans.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering, or related roles.
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Other relevant degrees may be considered depending on experience.
Experience managing technical programs involving energy storage, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing applications.
Strong technical understanding of precision components, material processing, assemblies, electrical and mechanical assemblies, and customized manufactured parts.
Experience with manufacturing processes such as die-cutting, stamping, molding, laminating, converting, assembly, and automation-related integration.
Familiarity with engineered materials, including films, tapes, adhesives, insulation materials, plastics, foams, and metals.
Strong project management, communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional coordination skills.
Experience supporting R&D, NPI, qualification, validation, and production ramp activities.
Ability to work effectively with customers, suppliers, and internal teams across the US and Asia.
Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed to support customer meetings, factory visits, engineering builds, audits, and program launches.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical and program information across customers, suppliers, and internal teams.

We are seeking a motivated Agile Product Manager, known internally as a Neighborhood Lead, to join our Wealth Delivery team and help build a modern, scalable Wealth platform that improves the experience of clients, advisors, and stakeholders.

Position Overview:
The Neighborhood Lead is a senior Agile Product Manager responsible for translating Wealth Town strategy into a clear neighborhood-level product vision, roadmap, and prioritized set of initiatives. This leader guides and coaches Experience Owners — Citizens’ internal equivalent of Product Owners — across multiple pods to ensure discovery, prioritization, backlog health, delivery readiness, and value realization remain aligned to customer outcomes and strategic objectives.

Consistent with Citizens’ Agile operating model, the Neighborhood Lead prioritizes the neighborhood backlog, supports release planning, and partners with Experience Owners to translate product strategy into MVPs, features, stories, and measurable business value. This role requires a collaborative, customer-centric, digital-first leader who can combine product management discipline with agile execution leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Product Vision & Strategy: Translate Town and Enterprise strategic priorities into a compelling neighborhood product vision, objectives, OKRs, themes, initiatives, and roadmap. Ensure product strategy aligns with customer outcomes, business priorities, technology modernization goals, and measurable value realization. Define and communicate product strategy aligned to business goals, customer outcomes, financial impacts, organizational change considerations, and technology capacity.
Experience Owner / Product Owner Leadership: Lead, coach, and enable Experience Owners — Citizens’ internal equivalent of Product Owners — to translate product strategy into MVPs, prioritized epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery-ready backlogs. Establish clear product management expectations, reinforce accountability, provide ongoing coaching and constructive feedback, and promote strong ownership, customer focus, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement across pods.
Customer, Advisor & Journey Discovery: Partner with Experience Owners, stakeholders, advisors, operations teams, and technology partners to understand user needs, pain points, behaviors, and opportunities. Use discovery, user research, market analysis, journey mapping, and data insights to inform product direction and ensure solutions are designed from the customer and advisor point of view.
Roadmap, Backlog & Prioritization: Guide and maintain the neighborhood roadmap and integrated backlog prioritization in partnership with Experience Owners and delivery teams. Prioritize initiatives, epics, features, and user stories based on customer value, business impact, risk, feasibility, dependencies, and strategic alignment. Ensure the most valuable work is delivered first while maintaining technical integrity and long-term platform scalability.
Agile Product Delivery & Release Readiness: Lead agile product execution across multiple pods by supporting release planning, sprint readiness, backlog refinement, product demos, and acceptance criteria. Partner with Scrum Masters, Agile Coaches, technology teams, and Experience Owners to remove impediments, manage dependencies, and ensure teams deliver against agreed quality, scope, and value expectations. Foster an agile mindset across pods by promoting iterative delivery, transparency, continuous learning, and cross-pod collaboration while ensuring teams maintain delivery discipline and focus on customer value.
Stakeholder Alignment & Decision Facilitation: Serve as a product leader and decision facilitator across business, technology, risk, compliance, operations, vendors, and executive stakeholders. Communicate product priorities, tradeoffs, progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly and concisely. Facilitate alignment when priorities compete or alternatives are complex. Promote transparency, shared accountability, and clear decision ownership across business, technology, risk, compliance, operations, and delivery partners.
Business Value, Metrics & ROI: Define and track product outcomes, Objectives and Key Results, key performance indicators, adoption measures, and business value realization. Partner with the Town Lead, Town Manager, finance partners, and stakeholders to support funding requests, business cases, resource planning, ROI tracking, and investment prioritization.
Platform, Vendor & Cross-Pod Alignment: Coordinate across pods and vendor partners to ensure product decisions align with Wealth platform strategy, enterprise architecture, risk and compliance expectations, operational readiness, and long-term modernization goals. Identify and prioritize cross-journey enablers, shared platform needs, and dependencies that improve the end-to-end client, advisor, and colleague experience.
Change Readiness & Adoption: Partner with business, operations, training, communications, and change management teams to support successful product launches, adoption, and stabilization. Lead and support the organization's transition toward product-based delivery by reinforcing product ownership, roadmap-driven planning, customer-centric prioritization, iterative delivery, and measurable business outcomes.
Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Foster a culture of experimentation, retrospectives, feedback loops, and continuous improvement. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve team efficiency, enhance product quality, reduce friction, and deliver innovative digital capabilities that advance the Wealth Management experience.

Key Skills And Competencies

Product Management Leadership: Ability to define product vision, shape roadmap strategy, manage prioritized backlogs, make tradeoff decisions, and guide products from concept through delivery and adoption.
Customer and Journey Focus: Strong ability to understand client, advisor, colleague, and stakeholder needs and translate those insights into intuitive, scalable, and measurable product outcomes.
Agile Delivery Fluency: Strong understanding of agile methodologies, backlog refinement, release planning, sprint readiness, product demos, acceptance criteria, dependency management, and continuous delivery practices.
Strategic Thinking and Execution: Ability to translate strategy into actionable initiatives, balance short-term delivery with long-term platform direction, and drive measurable outcomes in a complex environment.
Stakeholder Influence and Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, executive presence, and ability to influence across business, technology, risk, compliance, operations, and vendor partners.
Leadership and Coaching: Ability to set direction, coach Experience Owners and agile teams, influence without formal authority, and foster a collaborative culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Domain Expertise: Demonstrated expertise in Wealth Management technology, financial services delivery, digital platforms, or a related technical or functional area.

Qualifications

Experience: 10+ years of proven experience leading complex product, platform, program, or technology delivery organizations within financial services, preferably within Wealth Management.
Product Management: Demonstrated experience defining product vision, developing roadmaps, prioritizing backlogs, translating strategy into MVPs, and delivering products or capabilities that create measurable customer and business value.
Experience Owner Leadership: Experience leading or coaching Product Owners, Experience Owners, Agile Pods, or cross-functional product teams through discovery, prioritization, delivery, release, and adoption.
Agile Skills: Strong understanding of agile product management practices, including backlog management, user stories, acceptance criteria, release planning, dependency management, and delivery governance. Proficiency with agile delivery and collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Regulatory & Operational Acumen: Working knowledge of Broker/Dealer and Registered Investment Advisor operating models, regulatory considerations, advisor workflows, supervisory processes, and client servicing capabilities to ensure product decisions support both business growth and compliance objectives.
Wealth Management Platforms: Extensive first-hand experience delivering innovation with Wealth Management technology platforms. Proven history managing multiple large, complex products. Deep understanding of account onboarding, account servicing, advisor workstation, brokerage, registered investment advisor (RIA), and investment management platforms preferred.
Stakeholder Leadership: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, make tradeoff decisions, influence stakeholders, remove impediments, and drive aligned outcomes across matrixed teams.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise executive updates and facilitate decision-making discussions.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience; Master’s degree preferred.

Work Schedule

Weekly Hours: 40

Weekly Schedule: Monday - Friday

Pay Transparency

The salary range for this position is $175,000 - $242,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States. For an overview of our benefits, visit https://jobs.citizensbank.com/benefits .

We are strengthening our Digital Channels capabilities and are looking for a Senior Business Analyst to play a key role in shaping our Pan‑Baltic websites platform.

In this role, you will work alongside business stakeholders, IT, and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into robust and scalable digital solutions 

This position is well suited for an experienced analyst who enjoys working at the intersection of business and technology, thrives in complex environments, and can independently drive initiatives from idea to implementation.

Translating business needs into clear functional and nonfunctional requirements for new software solutions
Collaborating with IT, architects, developers, and vendors throughout the full development lifecycle (analysis, design, testing, rollout)
Supporting implementation and integration of new tools and platforms
Supporting enhancement of recurring credit risk monitoring and performance reports

Ability to structure complex problems and translate business needs into clear specifications
Experience working with multiple stakeholders in a large, matrix organization
Solid understanding of data, reporting, and KPIs (e.g. SQL, BI tools, data warehouses – an advantage)

Excellent analytical thinking, communication, and documentation skills

Wellbeing. Access to tools and resources that help you feel good and be productive at work and in life
Professional growth. Internal and external training programs, LinkedIn learning, workshops, conferences, online training, etc

Join a high-growth fintech environment where data, experimentation, and technology are central to how growth decisions are made.

You’ll help drive the performance of paid acquisition channels such as Meta, Google, and TikTok while taking ownership of analytical strategy and optimization.

The role combines quantitative analysis, User Acquisition expertise, automation, and applied AI to increase both acquisition efficiency and scale.

You’ll have autonomy to own channels, identify new growth opportunities, and establish analytical foundations for emerging paid media platforms.

Working closely with the Growth team, you’ll turn performance data into clear hypotheses, experiments, and actionable recommendations.

You’ll also bring external benchmarks and modern acquisition frameworks to continuously raise the standard of paid media operations.

This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact in a fast-moving, data-driven environment while helping shape a rapidly scaling growth function.

Proven experience in User Acquisition and Paid Media, with a track record of managing meaningful budgets across at least one major channel such as Meta, Google, TikTok, or DSPs and successfully scaling investment while maintaining efficiency.
Strong quantitative reasoning and fluency in acquisition metrics including CAC/pCAC, ROAS, CPM, and CVR across different stages of the funnel.
Ability to independently investigate performance using spreadsheets, SQL, BI tools, or similar analytical technologies without relying heavily on other teams for basic analysis.
Practical, hands-on use of AI in day-to-day work, combined with genuine interest in building AI agents and automation that improve analytical and operational efficiency.
Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take responsibility for a channel, establish processes, define priorities, and operate autonomously in an evolving environment.

Annual learning budget to support continuous professional development.

The Compensation and Operations Analyst supports the Total Rewards and Compensation team by performing job-to-survey mapping, monitoring pay compliance for Service Contract Act (SCA)-covered employees, reviewing compensation change requests, and maintaining accurate job structure data. This role also provides cross-functional support to the Performance Management, Pricing/Proposal/Capture, and HR Operations teams, including new hire orientation. Review compensation change forms (promotions, transfers, adjustments) in Dayforce for internal and external equity alignment; confirm that each request results in an appropriate job/grade assignment.
Run and maintain routine compensation reports; audit job structure data to ensure all required fields are complete and accurate (Workers' Compensation codes, job descriptions, pay grades, FLSA status, etc.).
Support the annual and special compensation cycles by responding to manager and employee inquiries under the direction of the Compensation Manager.
Serve as backup support in providing salary survey data to the Pricing, Proposal, and Capture teams, as needed.

Performance Management Support

Support managers with system navigation and process questions during the performance review cycle.

HR Operations Support

Lead new hire orientation sessions and assist with onboarding tasks as needed.

Qualifications

Required

0–2 years of experience in compensation, HR, or a related analytical role (internships count).
Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, basic formulas).
High attention to detail and comfort working with structured data and audits.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain compensation concepts to non-specialists.
Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

Preferred

Exposure to government contracting compensation concepts (SCA, wage determinations, FAR 31.205-6).
Familiarity with an HRIS platform (e.g., Dayforce, Workday, UKG).
Prior experience with salary survey data or job-matching processes.

jobs.description:
Project Manager, Hardscape and Masonry

VistaVerde | Rockville, MD | Full-time | $70,000 to $85,000 base plus per-job completion bonus |
About the job

VistaVerde builds patios, walkways, retaining walls, masonry and outdoor living spaces for homeowners and general contractors across Montgomery County and the surrounding area. We are a small, crew-based company growing fast. Right now the owner sells the work and runs the field. This role takes the field off his plate so he can stay in front of clients.
You will own every active job from signed contract to final walkthrough: the schedule, the crews, the materials, the subs, and the client while the work is live. You are the person on the job who makes the call, and the person the crew calls first.
We are hiring someone who has already done this job. This is not a training role.
What you will own

Run every active job against the contract, the budget and the schedule. Three to four jobs at a time in season.
Plan tomorrow the night before: who is on which site, start time, what goes on the truck. One plan, sent once.
Lead the morning crew huddle. Walk the site before the crew arrives and confirm the address, the layout, the materials and the access.
Order and stage materials off the estimate so no crew waits on a delivery or a store run.
Manage subcontractors: scope, price, schedule, quality, and sign-off before they get paid.
Keep the client informed while the job is live. Answer their questions before they have to ask.
Handle change orders in the field. Get them priced and signed before the extra work starts.
Keep the project board current every day. Track labor and material costs against the estimate every week and flag drift early.
Close the job clean: punch list, final walkthrough, photos, and hand it to the office for invoicing.
Coach the crew leads. Hold the standard on safety, quality and cleanup.

What you bring

5+ years running residential hardscape, masonry, landscape construction or similar site work as a foreman, superintendent or project manager.
You have personally built patios, walls and walkways. You can read a layout, check base depth and compaction, and know when the work is wrong before the client does.
You have managed multiple crews and subs across several jobs at once.
You have handled homeowners on live jobs, including the hard conversations.
You can read an estimate and a plan and turn it into a material list and a build sequence.
Comfortable with a phone-based workflow: time clock app, CRM, shared calendar, photos from the field.
Valid driver's license, clean record, reliable transportation.
Spanish is a strong plus. Most of our crew is bilingual or speaks Spanish.

How we work

Four things we look for in every hire. Be honest with yourself before you apply.
You ask when it is unclear, then you go. You do not wait to be told twice.
You move without being told. Idle is a choice here, and it is the wrong one.
We hear it from you first. A problem you raise at 4 PM is a plan. The same problem at 7 AM is a lost crew day.
You answer with how, not why not.

What we offer

$70,000 to $85,000 base, depending on experience.
A completion bonus on every job that finishes on schedule and inside the labor estimate. Paid the month the job closes.
Company phone, mileage, and tools.
A February start. You learn our systems and clients on interior winter work, then run the spring and summer season with the process already in hand.
A real seat with a real number. You will know exactly what you own and how it is measured, and you will hear it from the owner directly. No layers.
Room to grow. This seat is built to run all of operations as we add a second full-time crew.]

How to apply

Apply on LinkedIn with your resume and a short note answering one question: tell us about a job that went sideways in the field and what you did about it. We read every one.

Follow through until every assigned task and project issue is fully resolved

Compare proposed work with actual field conditions and client requests
Identify work that falls outside the approved proposal
Prepare change-order information for management review before additional work begins

Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to deliver the emergency services program within Leo Global Customer Operations. This is a cross-functional role responsible for driving standardization, strategy, and execution of telecommunications and call center operations across American and international markets, ensuring customers can access critical emergency connectivity when every second matters.

You will build and run the day-to-day program, drive BPO partner strategy, launch readiness, and ongoing operational excellence for emergency services contact center operations spanning multiple countries, languages, and regulatory environments. You will apply your domain expertise in emergency services protocols, contact center operations, and global program management at scale to deliver the program successfully.

Key job responsibilities

Own the program strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end execution for our call center operations and telecom needs
Own vendor/BPO partner relationships for contact center operations including selection, onboarding, performance management, quality oversight, and service level governance
Execute and deliver scalable solutions that support multiple countries, languages and regulatory environments
Drive cross-functional coordination across internal and external teams including engineering, operations and other support teams
Develop and execute launch playbooks for new market expansions, ensuring operational readiness across training, technology, workforce planning, and compliance requirements
Establish and monitor key operational metrics, escalation frameworks, and continuous improvement mechanisms for emergency services delivery
Ensure compliance with emergency services standards, protocols, and regulatory requirements (e.g., eCall, NG911, E112) across all supported markets
Apply program management methodologies to develop large-scale project plans, milestones, and mechanisms that drive predictable outcomes across the program lifecycle

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
5+ years of experience in Public Safety, Emergency Response, or related emergency services domain

Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

Mission Driven, Community Focused
About | Charles R. Drew University of Medicine and Science (cdrewu.edu)

Charles R. Drew University is located in the Watts-Willowbrook area of south Los Angeles and was founded in 1966 in the wake of the Watts uprising. CDU was founded to address inadequate medical care in the region and to provide equitable medical education opportunities for underrepresented students.

CDU is strongly invested in the local and regional community. The university leads multiple partnerships and programs to provide equitable healthcare resources in a variety of south Los Angeles neighborhoods.

Job Summary

The Program Manager (PM) reports to the Department Chairs of their assigned departments. The Program Manager will be assigned to one of the department groupings such as:

Department of Pediatrics and Internal Medicine
Department of Biomedical Science Education and Preventive and Social Medicine
Department of Surgery, Obstetrics and Gynecology, and Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

The Program Manager primary role is to manage the department fiscal and organizational structural and respond to University requests. The Program Manager will interact with departmental leadership and faculty daily to achieve their education strategy . The Program Manager is directly responsible for all administrative operations encompassed within the Department’s mission areas of teaching, research, and service. The Program Manager will closely monitor and ensure contracts and service agreements are current and updated on an annual basis or as needed. In partnership with the Chair and faculty leadership, the Program Manager will be responsible for short- and long-term strategic planning to develop departmental administrative and financial goals and objectives.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Responsible for the financial reporting of the department
Serve as the primary point of contact.
Assist in the development of spreadsheets to track grant funding and implementation.
Develop and format grant budgets, narratives, and other supporting documents.
Create templates for (letters, Memoranda of Understanding, etc.)
Coordinate quality control checks and review all grant materials.
Keep the team up to date on project progress and report any delays in a timely fashion
Serve as a liaison and or delegate to staffing changes and or management to the PI
Assist in any post-award grant revisions and conduct debrief to share feedback on unfunded grants.
Serve as the liaison between the PI and the Office of Sponsored Programs
Provides administrative management and oversight of all aspects of the contract and grant activity for the department by ensuring that the staff and principal investigators are following all regulations in accordance with university policy and sponsor guidelines including Federal, State, Private and Institutional sponsors.
In conjunction with the Chair, the PM develops the annual departmental budget considering all revenue sources and departmental expenditures. They are responsible for forecasting, trending, and projecting budgetary needs for departmental expenses. Calculate project metrics; including (among others) quality assurance (QA), compliance, technical performance measures, strategic plan implementation.
Monitor the operational budget and variance reports on a monthly basis to provide the Chair with an analysis and expectation of meeting financial goals to maintain solvency.
In conjunction with the centralized contracting office participates in the negotiation of financial contracts with outside companies, individuals, etc. for professional services on behalf of the faculty and department
Work with teams to create and standardize processes to reach team goals.
Oversees the work of contracted consultants/providers to ensure fidelity with the scope of work, sponsor, and CDU requirements.
Assist with grant budget preparations
Monitor all grant materials and request changes to ensure that they strictly adhere to funder requirements
Package and submit properly completed and timely grant applications per funders’ requirements to the Office of Sponsored Programs for final review and submission.
Ensure that all application documents are uploaded and filed upon completion
Process invoices and reimbursements using the eRequester software and reconciles expenditures to departmental budgets.
Use project management tools to document and track project performance, specifically to streamline communication and analyze the progress towards short and long-term goals.
Creates and distributes reports, summaries, and analyses as required.
Take minutes at meetings
Attends conferences and training as required by supervisor to maintain proficiency.
Participates in Department and College of Medicine activities as directed by the Chair.
Serves as a liaison with other departments, the COM Dean’s office, other campus offices/organization, community agencies and partners
Manages systems and procedures to maintain departmental assets and departmental administrative organization
Plans and implements ongoing recruitment for academic personnel, prepare and maintain personnel requisition records to ensuring compliance with academic personnel policies and procedures
Assists with the faculty review, merit, and promotion process
Develops resource commitments and participates in the negotiation of salaries for new faculty and assesses financial/program impact of new faculty and services
As growth or change demands, evaluates current structure for efficiency and effectiveness in relation to function and develops policies to implement plans for adjustment, if necessary

Other Duties And Responsibilities

Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications/Requirements

EDUCATION:

Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.
Public health and/or health services concentrations preferred.

Experience

Experience with Academic personnel titles, series, and rank as it relates to merit and promotion policies and procedures.
Experience in navigating in a large, complex organization with an understanding of the big picture; how the parts fit together and how to get the information necessary to resolve problems and troubleshoot.
Demonstrated experience with financial management including budget and report preparation, analysis and forecasting across multiple funding sources from affiliation agreements, federal, state general and contract funds, grants, gifts, endowments, education, and professional fee revenue.
Proven working experience in grant, project and database management.
Experience in conducting long and short-range financial
Experience in higher education, accreditation, and healthcare agencies.
Experience with software technology; strong technical aptitude in working with project management applications.
Experience with program evaluation and/or survey-based research approaches Demonstrated ability, using critical thinking skills, to effectively lead, manage, supervise and strategically plan administrative and fiscal operations.
Advanced management/leadership experience in an academic healthcare
Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge/Ability/Skills

Excellent interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to use various computer programs to create systems tailored towards the needs of the Pediatrics and Internal Medicine Departments. High energy, self-motivated team player.
Initiative to seek alternative approaches and solutions.
Proficient and adept with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Power Point, Sharepoint, and Access).
Proficient and adept with collaboration software including Zoom and Microsoft Teams.
Working knowledge of Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap), New Innovations, and BlackBoard systems preferred.
Ability to make budgets
Ability to make procedural decisions and judgments with the guidance of the PI.
Knowledge of grant funding policies and procedures and applicable local, state, federal and university regulations

Complexity

The ability to perform highly detailed work with sustained attention and care while providing/obtaining information on numerous inquiries is paramount to success in this position.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Occasional stooping. Frequent standing. Constant walking, sitting, climbing, reaching high/low levels, finger movement, feeling, speaking clearly, hearing conversationally, and seeing far and near.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Occasionally required to work in confined space.
Position is on-site unless specific authorization from the manager.

Mental Demands

The mental demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Frequent work on a variety of unrelated tasks. Constant calculating interrupted work, work on a variety of interrelated tasks, and use of sustained concentration, reasoning, judgment, resourcefulness, analytical ability, and ingenuity.

Special Requirements

Ability to work effectively with a diverse community.
Applicants must be an underrepresented minority (URM) from ethnic or racial backgrounds as defined by the National Institutes of Health. See https://diversity.nih.gov/about-us/population-underrepresented.

As a condition of enrollment and employment, proof of the newest COVID-19 booster will be required for CDU students, faculty, and staff entry to the CDU campus. Please note that vaccination requirements may change as our Federal, State, and local public health laws change. Requests for disability and religious accommodations from faculty and staff will be evaluated consistent with the law and University policies and procedures.

Saab Australia is an industry participant in the Combat Systems Integration – Integrated Project Team (CSI-IPT) Collaboration Agreement (CSI-IPT CCA). The CSI-IPT CCA forms a collaborative enterprise organisation to execute scopes of work across Hobart Class Destroyer (SEA4000 Phase 6 and other related Destroyer Capability Enhancement (DCE) upgrades) and the Hunter Class Frigates (HCFs - SEA5000 Phase 1). This will see independently executed programs such as SEA4000 Phase 6 and SEA5000 Phase 1 brought under one umbrella enterprise organisation, the CSI-IPT.

The CSI-IPT will be built up with personnel from three industry participants and the Commonwealth of Australia (CoA) to form a collaborative team working across multiple programs to leverage synergies between platforms.

The role

The Project Manager
will support the developing and delivering a wide range of tasks contributing to the combat systems solutions for the Destroyer Capability Enhancement (DCE) Program and be responsible for delivering outcomes on small to medium projects.

Further, the successful candidate will:

Foster a positive collaborative culture between the key project stakeholders and the project team including the customer (both external and internal), and other stakeholders.
Manage the development and execution of Tasking Statements to cost and schedule.
Develop Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Basis of Estimates (BoE) and support the required approval process within the organisations and CSI-IPT.
Lead and present status at Steering Committee Meetings, Gate Reviews, Customer Reviews and Progress Meetings.
Prepare, monitor and revise project plans, estimates, cost accounts and schedules for the project to meet the objectives set by the Contract/Project Directive.
Manage and Support the development of all appropriate Tasking Statement Proposals.
Identify Value for Money (VFM) initiatives for proposals that will improve project outcomes for the company and customers.

Flexible work arrangements such as hybrid work from home / office and a 9-day fortnight will be considered for this role.

Tertiary qualifications in Science, Engineering or in a Business discipline.
Minimum 5 years’ experience in a project management or bid management role (essential), preferably in Defence or Naval projects (desirable).
Demonstrated understanding of planning, scheduling and Earned Value Management Techniques (EVM).

Demonstrated ability in managing proposals and preparing briefing packs for Participant Executive Level approvals.
Demonstrated experience with Deltek Open Plan Professional is required

and hold or be able to obtain an Australian Defence Security Clearance to NV1 level. Information including past and present nationality and citizenship may be requested to check eligibility for access to materials controlled under various export control regimes, including ITAR.

Apply today to join our crew and deliver solutions with purpose!

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden.
